_comment: MVP1.G3 OBS-1 item 7 grandfather baseline. Every entry below was manually reviewed against the real EN/RU strings on 2026-08-27 and confirmed to be a translation-idiom difference, NOT a meaning-changing drift -- see core/DECISION_LOG.md's item-7 entry for the full audit. `expiry` binds the WHOLE baseline: once past it, check_ru_en_drift.js fails on every entry here too, so this list must be re-reviewed (fixed, or re-baselined with a fresh expiry and a fresh reason) rather than carried forever.

commonSomethingWentWrong.reason: EN 'went wrong' has no literal negation word; RU 'пошло не так' is the standard idiom for it. Verified same meaning.

scannerFailedBody.reason: Same 'went wrong' idiom as commonSomethingWentWrong. Verified same meaning.

formcheckRepFaulted.reason: EN 'was off' has no literal negation word; RU 'было не так' is the equivalent idiom. Verified same meaning.

aboutNoDataResaleEver.reason: RU 'Никакой' (no standalone не-particle) renders EN 'No'. Verified same meaning.

catalogNothingToModerateGreatWork.reason: RU 'нечего' (nothing) renders EN 'Nothing', no standalone не-particle in this word. Verified same meaning.

workoutsEmptyFiltered.reason: EN 'Nothing in X yet' rendered as RU 'в X пока пусто' (X is empty for now) -- no standalone не-particle on the RU side. Verified same meaning.

equipmentOffline.reason: EN 'OFFLINE' has no negation word; RU 'БЕЗ СЕТИ' (without network) is the natural RU rendering. Verified same meaning.

momentsWeReANonprofitAndThe.reason: EN 'stays free of safety paywalls' rendered as RU 'нет платных стен' (there are no paywalls). Verified same meaning.

subscriptionEveryLevelKeepsTheAppFree.reason: Same 'free of paywalls' -> 'без платных стен' idiom as momentsWeReANonprofitAndThe. Verified same meaning.

scannerTryFillingTheFrameWithOne.reason: EN 'avoid people or clutter' rendered as RU 'без людей и лишних предметов' (without people or extra items). Verified same meaning.

onbDietGlutenFree.reason: EN 'Gluten-free' -> RU 'Без глютена' (without gluten), same -free idiom pattern. Verified same meaning.

onbDietDairyFree.reason: Same -free idiom as onbDietGlutenFree. Verified same meaning.

subscriptionCouldNotCheckPlanBody.reason: EN 'is unaffected' rendered as RU '... не затронут' (is not affected) -- opposite grammatical polarity, same meaning. Verified.

settingsRemindersOffBody.reason: EN 'stay silent' rendered as RU 'проходят без звука' (happen without sound). Verified same meaning.

onbBarrierExerciseChoice.reason: EN is a short noun-phrase onboarding label ('Choosing exercises'); RU renders it as a natural first-person barrier sentence ('Не знаю, какие...' = 'I don't know which...'). Verified same intended meaning (a barrier the user picks).

onbBarrierMachineUse.reason: Same onboarding-barrier pattern as onbBarrierExerciseChoice. Verified same meaning.

onbBarrierTime.reason: Same onboarding-barrier pattern as onbBarrierExerciseChoice ('Не хватает времени' = 'there isn't enough time'). Verified same meaning.

equipmentFaultQrMissing.reason: EN 'QR missing' -> RU 'Нет QR-кода' (there is no QR code). Verified same meaning.

formcheckMissingAnswers.reason: EN 'Still needed' -> RU 'Не хватает' (lacking/not enough). Verified same meaning.

coachSettling.reason: EN 'Hold still' -> RU 'Не двигайтесь' (don't move) is the natural RU instruction for the same stillness request. Verified same meaning.

safetyScreeningIntro.reason: EN 'a wrong answer' -> RU 'неверный ответ' (lexicalized не-adjective, no standalone particle). Verified same meaning.

eligReasonClinician.reason: EN 'advised you against exercising' -> RU 'не рекомендовал' (advised against / did not recommend). Verified same meaning.

profileLinkAccountSubtitle.reason: EN 'unless X already has a profile' is logically 'if X does not yet have a profile', which is exactly what the RU 'если ... ещё нет профиля' says. Verified logically equivalent.

marketplaceVettedCoachesWhoRun11.reason: EN literal '1:1' is rendered as the RU word 'индивидуальные' (individual) instead of a numeral; the 15% fee figure is preserved unchanged on both sides. Verified same meaning.

profileBrowse11Sessions15Fee.reason: Same '1:1' -> 'индивидуальные' word choice as marketplaceVettedCoachesWhoRun11; 15% preserved. Verified same meaning.

onbEnvOneOnOne.reason: EN '1-on-1' -> RU 'один на один' (one-on-one spelled as words, not digits). Verified same meaning.

subPeriodAnnual.reason: EN '~50%' -> RU 'вдвое' (twice / half-price), a looser but equivalent rendering of the same discount. Verified same meaning.

formcheckPrepAngleValue.reason: EN 'From the side' (4 words) vs RU 'Сбоку' (one adverb) -- short-string length-ratio noise, both correctly name the same camera angle. Verified same meaning.
